title: A service outside the catalog is flagged, not priced
query: Proposal for Brightwater Legal: 25 staff. They want Managed IT Support (Core) and Microsoft 365 Backup for all 25, on a 12-month term from 1 March 2027. They also asked us to include a penetration test of their network. Contact is Sam Okafor, Office Manager. Date it 16 November 2026.

expected.rubric: The assistant's final reply tells the salesperson that a penetration test is not something the company's catalog offers, so it was not priced (it may say it was listed as not included).

_oracle: What a correct run produces. graders.test.ts builds it with the real scripts and expects every code check to pass.

notIncluded: A penetration test of the network: it isn't part of our catalog.
